sources.title: Mahjong(g) Before Mahjong(g) — The Mahjong Tile Set

notes: 麻将发明人传说众多（含郑和等），均缺乏实证。较稳妥的看法是十九世纪后期由马吊、纸牌等博戏在江浙闽沿海定型，宁波常被当作重要传播中心，但福州等地亦有早期牌具记载，精确发明人与年份仍有争议。
notes_en: Legends about mahjong’s inventor, including Zheng He, lack evidence. A safer view is that it took shape from games such as madiao and playing cards on the Jiangsu–Zhejiang–Fujian coast in the late nineteenth century. Ningbo is often seen as a dissemination center, but early tile sets are also recorded in Fuzhou and elsewhere; the inventor and exact year remain disputed.
summary_zh: 麻将约于十九世纪后期在中国东南沿海定型，宁波常被视作重要中心；发明人传说很多，精确年份仍有争议。
summary_en: Mahjong took shape on China’s southeast coast in the late 19th century, with Ningbo often seen as a key center. Legends about its inventor abound; the exact year remains disputed.
summary_ja: 麻雀は19世紀後半に中国南東部の沿岸で形が定まり、寧波が重要な中心地とされることが多い。発明者については多くの伝説があり、正確な年にはなお異説がある。
